title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article (Rules for the Enforcement of the Basic Act on Agriculture, Rural Areas, and the Food Industry) <Article 180, December 23, 2015>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from December 23, 2015.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Regulations) Items ① to ⑧ are omitted.

⑨ The following amendments are made to part of the Rules for the Enforcement of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the Livestock Support Fund:

Article 7, paragraph 1, shall be amended to read: "Article 3, paragraph 2, item (a) of the 'Basic Act on Agriculture, Rural Areas, and the Food Industry'."
